press.title: Press kit
press.lede: Everything needed to write about, stream, or record our games. If something you need is missing, ask — we would rather send it than have you go without.
press.permissionVideo: You have our blanket permission to record, stream, and monetise video of any {{studio}} game, including full playthroughs. No further clearance needed, and nothing here will ever get you a copyright strike from us.
press.permissionLogos: Logos and key art may be used in coverage of our games. Please do not alter the logo’s colours or proportions, or use it to imply that we endorse a product.
press.permissionKeys: Review keys and preview builds: <mail>{{email}}</mail>. Tell us the outlet or channel and which game — that is all we need.

about.title: About
about.body1: {{studio}} is a small independent studio building tight, replayable action games — the kind you start a fifteenth run of because the fourteenth ended badly and you know exactly why.
about.body2: We build in Godot, we ship on PC first, and we keep the scope honest: a complete game that respects the hours you put into it beats a bigger one that needs you to keep paying attention.
about.body3: The part we care most about is how the games are sold. That is the whole reason this page exists rather than a store bio.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: What Spartan Game Studios collects, why, and how to remove it.
privacy.lede: This policy describes what this website and our accounts system collect. It is written to be specific rather than reassuring — everything below reflects what the software actually does.
privacy.noTracking: This site runs no analytics, no advertising, and sets no tracking cookies of its own; our fonts are self-hosted, not pulled from a font network. The one exception is a game's page, which embeds Steam's official store widget — opening that page loads content from Valve and may let Steam set its own cookies. Every other page reports your visit to no one.
privacy.accountIntro: Accounts are optional. If you create one, we store:
privacy.accountEmail: Your email address, and whether you have confirmed it.
privacy.accountProfile: A display name, and — if you signed in with Google — the profile name and photo Google provides.
privacy.accountLinked: Identifiers for any Steam or itch.io account you choose to link. We store the identifier only; we do not receive your password, and for Steam we never see your library.
privacy.accountFollowing: The games you have chosen to follow.
privacy.accountNoAccount: You can browse the entire site without an account. Nothing above is collected unless you create one.
privacy.servers: Our accounts server runs on hardware we rent in Helsinki, Finland. The website itself is served by GitHub Pages.
privacy.logs: Our web server keeps standard access logs, which include IP addresses, for security and debugging. GitHub also logs requests to the site as part of hosting it.
privacy.thirdPartiesIntro: We contact other services in the cases below. Except for the Steam widget on a game's page, this happens only when you ask:
privacy.thirdGoogle: Google — only if you sign in with Google. Their sign-in script loads when you open the sign-in page.
privacy.thirdSteam: Steam — its official store widget loads on a game's page, and Steam is contacted again if you link a Steam account.
privacy.thirdItch: itch.io — only if you link an itch.io account.
privacy.thirdEmail: Proton — delivers our email. They handle the message and your address in doing so.
privacy.thirdHosting: GitHub and Hetzner — host the site and the server respectively.
privacy.thirdNoSelling: We do not sell your data, share it for advertising, or pass it to anyone not listed here.
privacy.email: We email you to confirm your address. If we later email you about a game you follow, that will be because you followed it, and every such message will let you stop receiving them.
privacy.support: If you contact us for support, we keep that conversation so we can answer it and refer back to it. It may include your address and whatever you tell us.
privacy.rightsDelete: Delete your account and the data held with it, from
privacy.rightsAccess: Ask for a copy of what we hold about you.
privacy.rightsCorrect: Ask us to correct anything that is wrong.
privacy.rightsContact: For anything not covered by the buttons on this site, email
privacy.children: This site is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly create accounts for anyone under 13. If you believe a child has created one, email us and we will remove it.
privacy.changes: If this policy changes in substance, the date at the top changes with it. We will not quietly widen what we collect.
privacy.contact: Questions about this policy can go to
